title: Fixture cases of one test or catalog tool
description: The runs compa expert check makes of one test against a fixture artifact root, through the engine's loader and runner, and what each must return, compared exactly (docs/EXPERT_API.md §Fixture cases).

tool.description: The full ID of the test whose fixtures directory holds the file.

root.description: The artifact root, relative to the file; inside the package for a package's cases.

modified.description: Every entry's modification time in the copy of the root the cases run over, since git keeps none.

requires.description: Labels the cases' covers must name between them.

credentials.description: Files the runs refuse as holding only credentials, as a deployment names them to the engine.

note.description: For people; the check reads none of it.

truncated.description: Whether the run says its output was cut; false where absent.

reason.description: What the engine says of a run that is not ok, whole; empty where absent.

output.description: The whole output; empty for a run that is not ok.
